_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that enables innovative, reliable and secure electronic payments across more than 200 countries and territories.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (this one no longer has the earlier 10-Ks' sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa

theme_watch.reason: Live: Visa's own FY2021 10-K says 'The global payments industry is undergoing significant and rapid technological change, including mobile and other proximity and in-app payment technologies, ecommerce, tokenization, cryptocurrencies, distributed ledger and blockchain technologies, and new authentication technologies such as biometrics, 3D Secure 2.0 and dynamic cardholder verification values or dCVV2.' It names a crypto offering of its own: 'We enable cryptocurrencies for everyday payments through our global presence, partnership approach and trusted brand.' The stock trades at 36.0x FY22E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of Visa's network specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that enables innovative, reliable and secure electronic payments across more than 200 countries and territories.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (this one no longer has the earlier 10-Ks' sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.09x; +64% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.42; conservative 2yr +8%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.1%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +21.1%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.1%/yr (FY12-FY21 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2022-08-26) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.09x (49.8% downside to Bear $101.92 / +45.7% upside to Bull $295.71) | Adj composite 2.17 vs market 2.59: gap -0.42 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +64% above the EPP floor $123.86 (22x FY22E $5.63) | Conservative 2-yr case: +7.8% total (+3.9%/yr) | At 36.0x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $268.32 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +18.7% YoY in Q3 FY22, forward revenues +18.7% (Q3 FY22 revenue growth (no FY22 revenue range)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
